name: Noble Acatziri Raiders

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: Improves a unit's attack capabilities for an extended period of time.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Encourage
attributes.text: This unit provides a morale bonus to nearby allies.

attributes.name: Resistant to Fatigue
attributes.text: Fatigue has less of an effect on this unit.

attributes.name: Guerrilla Deployment
attributes.text: This unit can deploy outside of the deployment zone.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Ignore Terrain
attributes.text: Speed penalties caused by the terrain are ignored by this unit.

attributes.name: Raider
attributes.text: This unit may set buildings on fire, cause more fire damage with torches and capture faster than other units.

short: Swift, silent raiders who make ideal battlefield scouts.
history: Thought to be of Thracian or Scythian descent, and believing themselves descended from Herakles himself, the warlike Agathyrsi, also known as Acatziri, lived on a plain that is now part of modern-day Romania from around 700BC. They were famous for their unusual, relaxed attitude to breeding - where everyone belonged to everyone else - which instilled a sense of brotherhood and common purpose within the tribe in order to prevent in-fighting. The Agathyrsi were also known for their fearsome appearance. Their blue hair and tattooed bodies were frightening on the battlefield and an unusual sight away from it; the amount of coverage indicating a warrior’s position within his tribe.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
